description.value: Donair Dude is a BC-born fast food chain that opened its first location during the 2010 Winter Olympics, growing from a single shop into a multi-location franchise serving Mediterranean-style donair wraps, platters, and poutine. The kitchen emphasizes locally sourced BC farm meats slowly roasted in-house, with a broad menu spanning chicken, beef, lamb, and dedicated vegan options. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making this a solid hot-meal stop for cyclists on the North Shore.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Donair Dude is an active fast food chain with online ordering, a full menu, and a 2025 copyright notice indicating current operation. The front page explicitly lists 'VEGAN' as a menu category and the menu page confirms numerous vegetarian/vegan items (falafel, tabouli, hummus, dolmades). OSM tags confirm indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes; however, no street address is present in OSM beyond unit number, and the website contact page shows only a Vancouver HQ address that does not match the North Vancouver OSM coordinates — the Store Locator subpage was not fetched so per-location details remain unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM record contains only addr:unit=230 with no street address — full location address for this North Vancouver node is unconfirmed.

Website contact page lists a Vancouver HQ address (101-310 East Kent Ave South, Vancouver, BC V5X 0A8) that does not correspond to the North Vancouver OSM coordinates; per-location address and phone were not found in the fetched pages.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active fast food chain with a live website, online ordering, and no indicators of closure; a real, publicly accessible meal stop useful to touring cyclists.
